title: Sharp functional quantization and empirical Wasserstein rates for Itô processes
summary: We establish functional quantization and empirical Wasserstein rates for continuous Itô processes under the supremum norm. We assume that the initial condition and the drift and diffusion integrands are controlled by a time-uniform random upper bound with a finite $ρ$-moment for some $ρ>1$. Under this assumption, the $n$-point $L^q$ quantization error is at most $C(\log n)^{-1/2}$ for every $1\leq q<ρ$.
